title: Short Oman Tour - 4 days
highlights: Visit Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque in Muscat.
Enjoy a desert safari in Wahiba Sands with sandboarding and camel rides.
Explore historic Nizwa Fort and its vibrant souq.
Relax at beautiful Qurum Beach in Muscat.
Take a family-friendly dhow cruise along the Muscat coastline.
overview: This three-night, four-day family-friendly Oman tour is perfect for families looking for a short yet memorable vacation. Explore the highlights of Muscat, enjoy a thrilling desert safari in Wahiba Sands and visit cultural landmarks such as Nizwa Fort. With comfortable accommodation, child-friendly activities and hassle-free travel, this tour balances culture, adventure and relaxation.

sections.title: A Short Family Escape in Oman
paragraphs: Experience the best of Oman in a limited time with a carefully planned itinerary that is enjoyable for children and adults.
Combine cultural exploration, desert adventure and time to relax on the coast with private transfers and comfortable accommodation.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Muscat
description: Transfer to your hotel and check in.
Visit Mutrah Corniche for a family stroll and explore vibrant Mutrah Souq.

itinerary.title: Desert Adventure in Wahiba Sands
itinerary.description: Travel to Wahiba Sands for a desert safari with sandboarding and camel rides. Enjoy the desert landscape and a memorable family adventure.

itinerary.title: Nizwa Fort and Return to Muscat
itinerary.description: Explore historic Nizwa Fort and the lively souq before returning to Muscat. Enjoy time at Qurum Beach or a family-friendly dhow cruise along the coastline.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for departure after breakfast.

included: 3 nights’ accommodation: 2 nights in Muscat and 1 night in a desert camp.
Daily breakfast and 1 traditional Omani dinner in the desert.
Private vehicle with a professional driver.
Desert safari with sandboarding and camel rides.
excluded: Lunch and dinner not mentioned in the itinerary.
goodToKnow: Oman is a safe and family-friendly destination with excellent facilities for children.
Modest attire is required when visiting mosques such as Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque.
Carry sunscreen, hats and reusable water bottles for outdoor activities.
Lightweight clothing is recommended for the desert and daytime activities.
